briefdescription.para: We're checking to see if we can fold LI into FoldInst.

detaileddescription.para: Note that we could have a sequence where multiple LLVM IR instructions are folded into the same machineinstr. For example we could have:
A: x = load i32 *P B: y = icmp A, 42 C: br y, ...
In this scenario, LI is "A", and FoldInst is "C". We know about "B" (and any other folded instructions) because it is between A and C.
If we succeed folding, return true.
